name: PRIMES
description: PRIMES has an internal floor that cannot descend. Every mint on TON PRIMES injects GRAM into the ratchet and emits strictly less value than it injects, so the internal floor p_f = T/S rises on every single mint and never falls — an arithmetic invariant, not a policy anyone can change. Prime mints emit no PRIMES at all and ratchet roughly 11x harder. The accumulated GRAM is spent only by a permissionless flush() that fills at or below p_f, so the protocol never buys above its own floor. Nothing else emits PRIMES: numbers bought at auction mint none. There is no admin withdraw path on any GRAM balance: not timelocked, not multisig, none. Every figure here is a public get-method you can recompute yourself at https://primes.live/verify. The market price on a DEX is not p_f and can move either way.
